meta.source: Nathan's Google Drive: watchdog.py (2026-05-15) — his own background process
meta.note: Nathan's Watchdog, implemented into the Brain as a maintainer of functionality alongside Sentinel.

identity: Watchdog — Temporal Guard Service. Protects the system from unstable state transitions and resource exhaustion.

loop.observe: Watches system pressure (frame time / CPU). Overloaded when pressure > threshold. XP in Fishing (watching the waves).
loop.process: Decides FAIL_SAFE vs MONITORING. XP in Stonecutting (hardening) when it engages.
loop.execute: Sets GLOBAL_THROTTLE on the authority hub — engaged when overloaded, released when clear. XP in Cooking (safety/sustenance).

brain_role: Second maintainer of the Brain, beside Sentinel. Sentinel watches correctness (contracts, cards, mechanics, budget); Watchdog watches pressure (load, frame health) and pulls the emergency brake.

engine_mapping.pressure_signal: frame time via the Mira governor (degrade above 33ms, recover below 23.1ms) + thermo T (churn)
engine_mapping.GLOBAL_THROTTLE: drives the existing auto-throttle: quality tiers step down while engaged, recover when released
engine_mapping.note: His logic stands as-is; only the pressure source and throttle target are wired to the engine's real governors.
